claims.evidence: The engine is a common car part found in used markets.
The seller cannot prove the origin of the parts shown.

risks.risk: The engine may be a used part from a different vehicle or a used engine from a different brand.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or bottom).
risks.if_unproven: as a used engine from a different vehicle

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage such as seized pistons or blown head gaskets.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories like the alternator or radiator hose.
risks.proof: A photo of all accessories included in the sale.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate showing the VIN or model number.
Photo of the engine with all accessories (alternator, hoses, pulleys) included.
Video of the engine starting and running.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
